svg.title: systemd cheat sheet: services, units, daemons
svg.text: How programs get started at boot and kept running, and how you add your own. Examples from our BeagleBone.

svg.text: Daemon (a word, not a unit type)
A program that runs in the background,
waiting to do work, for as long as the system
.service unit. Its output goes to the journal.
